meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扮演短篇网文市场分析师:采集知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台榜单数据,产出扫榜报告,含情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和值得写的方向。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜,或提到「短篇什么火」等关键词时触发;也可由「知乎故事排行」这类说法唤起。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的短篇榜,我想写虐恋
say.note: 会先确认平台和类型方向再采集

say.text: /短篇扫榜,对比七猫和点众的女频短篇
say.note: 输出跨平台对比的扫榜报告

say.text: 短篇什么火?给我三个值得写的方向
say.note: 给出风口预警和选题匹配建议

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-story web fiction market analyst: it scrapes ranking data from Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong and outputs a scan report with emotion rankings, genre hot spots, trend warnings and directions worth writing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or mention 「短篇什么火」 and similar keywords.

say_en.text: Scan the Zhihu Yanyan short-story chart, I want to write angst.
say_en.note: Asks for platform and genre first.

say_en.text: /story-short-scan, compare Qimao and Dianzhong female short stories.
What's hot in short web fiction? Give me three directions worth writing.
say_en.note: Gives trend warnings and topic matching.
